cases.name: exact-rational-uv
cases.notes: At x=0.1, exact complete U=2^-55; intermediate rounded subtraction incorrectly gives 2^-54.

cases.name: placed-mapping
cases.notes: Authored mapping stays in raw unplaced coordinates under cyclic rigid visual placement.

cases.name: unused-palette-binding
cases.notes: No region corners are referenced. Image is validated/inspectable; GLB has zero embedded images/textures.

cases.name: same-bytes-distinct-ids
cases.notes: Two declared IDs require two GLB images even though exact byte payloads match.

cases.name: maximum-decoded-default-budget
cases.notes: 262144 reconstructed channel-byte debits alone exceed the unchanged 100000 default.

cases.name: older-user-function-png-asset
cases.notes: Earlier user function and qualified calls are not asset declarations.

asymmetric-rgb.description: Literal 4 by 3 RGB array with twelve distinct texels

asymmetric-rgba.description: Non-square opaque RGBA array; Paeth, average, up and sub rows

filter-0.description: Same pixels encoded using PNG filter 0

filter-1.description: Same pixels encoded using PNG filter 1

filter-2.description: Same pixels encoded using PNG filter 2

filter-3.description: Same pixels encoded using PNG filter 3

filter-4.description: Same pixels encoded using PNG filter 4

idat-64.description: Exactly 64 contiguous IDAT chunks; zero-length chunks retained

caution-label.description: CAUTION glyphs and right arrow; red/green/blue/white corner markers

encoded-limit.description: Exactly 300000 encoded bytes, one complete zlib stream, five IDAT chunks

glb_invariants.uv: Exact authored binary64 rationals; complete dot/sum once to binary64 then binary32. Full regional accessor length equals position count; nonregional rows are positive zeros.
glb_invariants.image: Exact original PNG bytes and SHA256, one embedded image per used asset ID; unused declared IDs remain inspectable without dangling GLB resources.
glb_invariants.material: Existing linear baseColorFactor, metallic, roughness and back-face behavior unchanged; sRGB image decode precedes linear factor multiplication.
glb_invariants.raw_stream_rule: Match the corresponding untextured source under .12, by occurrence/region and accessor role rather than accessor index. Append UV/image data after existing streams.

motion.scope: Single-object Demo/shape cases. Assembly/generated occurrence records override initial pose and velocity.

glb_invariants.precision_boundary: No guaranteed UV detail resolution. UV underflow, coincidence and line projection are accepted appearance outcomes.

aggregate_boundary_reasoning.encoded: With at most four assets and each at most 300000 bytes, an isolated >1200000 aggregate satisfying both prior bounds is impossible.
aggregate_boundary_reasoning.decoded: With at most four assets and each at most 262144 reconstructed bytes, an isolated >1048576 aggregate satisfying both prior bounds is impossible.
aggregate_boundary_reasoning.coverage: Exact aggregate boundary cases plus distinct fifth-image and individual one-over refusals; no fictional isolated aggregate witness.
